reason: Hypothesis A proposes a physically sound grain-boundary segregation mechanism with a clear, testable intervention (5 at.% Ti) that directly addresses the ductility limitation without altering the single-phase BCC structure critical for high-temperature and irradiation performance. Hypothesis B relies on a phase inversion mechanism from a different alloy system (Al0.5NbTa0.8Ti1.5V0.2Zr) not demonstrated in NbMoTaW, and its predicted >20% ductility improvement is unsupported by evidence for this specific material, making it less grounded and riskier.
